description: This file defines synchronization utilities for handling IARM (Inter-Application Resource Management) event handlers, including templates for managing handler maps, registration, and removal functions with thread safety mechanisms.

classes.name: IarmHandlers
classes.description: Template class managing a static map of IARM event handlers keyed by owner strings.

methods.name: _generic_iarm_handler
methods.description: Generic static handler invoked on IARM events, calls the appropriate registered handler with thread safety.

methods.name: RegisterLockedIarmEventHandler
methods.description: Registers an event handler with thread safety, associating it with an owner and event ID.

methods.name: RemoveLockedEventHandler
methods.description: Removes an event handler with thread safety, ensuring the correct handler is unregistered.
